== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for R4-M9 (Arfour-Emmnine), cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 5 of the PC's ''Decipher Errata'' sheet “Official text as of March 1, 2017” (PDF made 31 May 2017): [http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf source], preserved copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705005900/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf Internet Archive]. Shown on [[R4-M9 (Arfour-Emmnine) (PC Errata 2017 slip)]].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-1/1e/Premiere-D-r4m9-PC-Errata-2017-slip.png Internet Archive item].
